title: Historical recording video
summary: Explain the person and the times, then play the full recording with subtitles.
description: Turn a historical recording, speech, interview, broadcast or archival footage into a video viewers will stay with. The first few minutes use photos, newspapers, maps and clips from the time to show who the speaker was, what they faced and why the talk mattered; then the full recording plays with original and translated subtitles, in chapters. Sources and licenses come first.
brief: Turn {{recording or footage}} into a history video: first explain {{speaker and occasion}} in a few minutes, then play the full recording, with subtitles in {{subtitle language}}.

fields.label: recording or footage
fields.hint: The attached file, a link or an archive catalog number, and its rough length

fields.label: speaker and occasion
fields.hint: Who, what year, where and to whom; if unsure, write "look it up"
fields.example: a writer's radio interview from the 1950s

fields.label: subtitle language
fields.hint: Subtitle language; if the speech is in another language, both are shown

beats: The first frame is a cover naming the person and occasion
A few minutes on the person, the situation and the stakes
Photos, papers and maps of the time move with the narration
The full recording with original and translated subtitles
Chapters, with sources and licenses listed at the end
